solver_notes: Native C11/pthreads + aarch64 assembly regression model executed on the physical Cortex-A72; this is not a claimed CPython patch. The deterministic suspended-pop schedule starts A->B->C, performs two pops plus A recycling, then resumes the suspended CAS. Pointer-only CAS reproduces ABA and installs stale B. The fixed head is an aligned 128-bit {pointer, uint64_t epoch} pair. Native LDAXP/STLXP implements acquire/release pair CAS without a mutex or libatomic fallback. Every pop/push increments the 64-bit epoch; the recycled A pointer has epoch 3, so the suspended epoch-0 CAS fails and retry follows A->C. One hundred thousand tagged ABA schedules reject all 100,000 stale writes; five repeated runs and UBSan pass. Objdump proves LDAXP/STLXP instructions in the binary. Scope is head-pointer ABA using preallocated nodes; general safe memory reclamation is not claimed.
